Discover the Human Body (Timberdoodle Review)

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:20
Instaread

My grandkids are always so excited to come visit me when I have new products from Timberdoodle to review, and this week one of my four-year-olds took a long look at Fun Facts Discover the Human Body Book.

This book takes kids on an amazing journey through the human body, teaching them about all the different systems along the way.

It is sure to help children discover how just fearfully and wonderfully made each of their bodies are. (see Psalm 139)

My grandson couldn’t get enough of this board book. He loved all the bright, colorful illustrations…

… and he especially loved lifting all the little flaps that fill every page, each of which reveals an inside view and even more interesting facts about what kids see underneath.

I was impressed with how easily my grandson was able to lift those tiny flaps. He really had an easier time of it than I did, despite the fact that my nails are longer and I’ve had many more years to practice my hand-eye coordination skills.

Discover the Human Body covers the respiratory system, showing exactly where the air goes one we breathe it in through our nose or mouth.

Discover the Human Body explains the importance of our skeletal and muscular systems, as well…

Kids learn about their neurological system. too, and tsee how their brain works. They also gain a better understanding and appreciation for their five senses.

Do you have a child who would enjoy reading Discover the Human Body? The book is available for individual purchase or as a part of Timberdoodle’s 2026 Kindergarten Curriculum kit.

And while you’re on the Timberdoodle website, I’d encourage you to look around. We love everything we’ve ever ordered from this small family-owned company!

Be sure to sign up for their Doodle Dollar program to save on future purchases. And to see more of my Timberdoodle Reviews, simply scroll to the bottom of my Homeschool Help page, and you can read them all!

PLEASE NOTE: As a member of the Timberdoodle blog team, I routinely receive free or deeply discounted products in exchange for writing honest reviews. Opinions expressed in these posts are 100% my own. I’ve been a happy and enthusiastic Timberdoodle customer for decades — long before I ever started blogging for their company.
